consequence.statement: The new --enableReporting flag is added with a default value that enables reporting for multiple rule types, providing new observability without requiring configuration changes.

assertion.statement: Kyverno 1.13 adds the --enableReporting container flag to admission-controller, background-controller, and reports-controller deployments with default value enabling reporting for validate, mutate, mutateExisting, imageVerify, and generate rule types.
